environment.description: Application deployed in EKS (1.28) behind an AWS ALB Ingress Controller. The ALB has three WAF WebACL rule groups attached in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictionRule_QUERYSTRING in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-uri-allowlist' that restricts paths to ^/api/v1/(users/profile|audit|health)$ with BLOCK action for non-matching, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted from an EFS volume with uid/gid restrictions. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the EFS mount target and kube-dns.

config.waf_rule_2: Custom rule group 'corp-uri-allowlist': StringMatchCondition on URI path, regex ^/api/v1/(users/profile|audit|health)$, default BLOCK
config.k8s_network_policy: egress allowed only to EFS mount target CIDR and kube-dns (UDP 53)
